style_en: Japanese TV anime style, clean bold line art, cel shading, calm muted colors, bright even light. Plain pure white background (#FFFFFF), no floor, no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no frame. Full body fully inside the image, filling the height, one single character centered.
avoid_en: text, letters, logo, modern clothes, nudity, human breasts, human arms on the siren, fish tail, mermaid, blood, skeleton, multiple characters, background scenery

siren.desc_en: a Siren of early Greek myth as painted on Archaic Greek vases: the body, wings, legs and tail of a large bird (like an eagle or a swan, with dark bronze-brown feathers and a pale cream breast) with only the head of a young woman about 20 with long dark wavy hair tied with a thin red ribbon, large dark eyes; no human arms, no human torso, no breasts, wearing nothing but feathers, bird talons

odysseus.desc_en: Odysseus, the Greek hero of the Odyssey, a weathered clever-looking man about 40 with short curly dark-brown hair and a short dark beard, sharp intelligent eyes, Archaic Greek clothing: a knee-length dull red wool chiton belted with leather, a brown traveling cloak pinned at one shoulder, a round felt pilos cap, leather sandals, no armor
